verdict.rationale: SolidJS is built on established JSX/TypeScript syntax and renders real DOM elements, supporting the 'familiar syntax' claim (solid-gh-18, solid-gh-5), and some users report an easy transition (solid-comm-2). However, hands-on community feedback concretely contradicts the 'minimizing new concepts' framing: reviewers call the API 'non-intuitive,' note that reactive primitives break with destructuring or early property access, and that every prop must be a function rather than a plain value—all genuinely new concepts beyond standard JS/HTML (solid-comm-4, solid-comm-5, solid-comm-11). Missing for 10: first-party acknowledgment/documentation of these learning-curve gotchas, and independent quantitative learning-curve comparisons.
